crest_safe_speed — DRIVE pass op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.crest_safe_speed(sight, *, reaction: 'float', brake: 'float', theta: 'float' = 0.0, c_rr: 'float' = 0.0, g: 'float' = 9.80665, crawl: 'float' = 2.7777777777777777) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivepass; drivepass.crest_safe_speed(sight, *, reaction: 'float', brake: 'float', theta: 'float' = 0.0, c_rr: 'float' = 0.0, g: 'float' = 9.80665, crawl: 'float' = 2.7777777777777777) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("crest_safe_speed"))

Usage

Maximum speed at which the vehicle can stop within the visible distance (inverse of the stopping distance, closed form, arrays allowed). Scenario S065.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

v ρ + v²/(2A) = S、A = brake + g sin θ + c_rr g cos θ(θ > 0 = 上り。drivelong.stopping_distance_grade の空気抵抗なしの式) を解いた v = 2S/(ρ + √(ρ² + 2S/A))。A ≤ 0 は ValueError。返り値: speed [m/s]、speed_kmh、crawl_required(42 条 2 号は頂上付近では速さによらず徐行 = True)、crawl_sufficient(徐行 crawl(仮定)で視距の中に止まれるか)。
